mechanism_summary_p1: FXFV2-A4-P1 monetizes the release of a measured Tokyo-session compression state through the London-morning breach of the overnight extremes: when the Tokyo range is below 0.75x its trailing-20-session median (a pre-session volatility state), the first completed London-morning [08:00-12:00 Europe/London) H1 bar breaching the Tokyo high/low triggers an entry at the next H1 open in the breach direction; exit on a completed close back inside the overnight range (next open) or the forced flat at the 16:00 America/New_York bar open on the entry UTC day. Mechanism rationale: thin near-touch liquidity plus resting stop/limit clusters just beyond compressed overnight extremes (Crabel 1990 narrow-range conditioning; Osler 2000 order-level evidence) met by the deterministic European activity surge (Andersen-Bollerslev-style intraday periodicity). Neighbour swaps the ratio threshold for a bottom-quartile rank rule; control replaces the extremes with the range midpoint on identical state-day machinery and should not reproduce the edge. Expected ~1.3 RT/pair/week (governor caps 1/day, 3/week).
mechanism_summary_p2: FXFV2-A4-P2 monetizes confirmed level migration after a London-morning range break: after the first completed [12:00-17:00 Europe/London) bar breaches the 08:00-12:00 London-AM extreme, entry at the next H1 open occurs ONLY when a later bar retests the broken level (touch) and closes back beyond it (retest-hold state - a post-break reaction state, with no volatility filter and no trailing lookback); exit on a completed close back inside the pre-break range or forced flat at the 16:00 America/New_York bar open on the entry UTC day. Mechanism rationale: stop clusters just beyond session extremes accelerate the break and limit liquidity migrates to the broken pole (Osler 2003; level-break predictive content per Brock/Lakonishok/LeBaron 1992); the retest-hold separates genuine absorption from liquidity-vacuum spikes. Neighbour re-tests the break bar's far extreme instead of the range extreme; control trades the complement state (failed retests, void days) in the same break direction and should not reproduce the anchor. Expected ~1.0 RT/pair/week (governor caps 1/day, 3/week).
